featured_reviews.name: Bosco Rodrigues
featured_reviews.review_text:
Only a bookstore. Also this book store only caters to SCHOOL TEXTBOOKS. Many schools use their services to provide academic textbooks. We had purchased the academic years textbooks from the school. One of the textbooks had missing pages. In order to replace the book, we visited this store. Once I showed the missing pages to the person at the counter, he was kind enough to acknowledge the mistake. He didn't require the bill (which we had carried with us) and he replaced the book, no questions asked.
In this case, I am happy with the service.

The store is within a compound on the main street leading to 'Pumo House'. There is an opportunity to park a car outside the compound. If you are heading there on a motorcycle, you can park in side the compound. The store can be spotted from the street with any hassles.
